title: AHD Agent: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Automatic Heuristic Design
abstract: arXiv:2605.08756v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automatic heuristic design (AHD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for solving NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems (COPs). Recent works show that large language models (LLMs), when integrated into well-designed frameworks (i.e., LLM-AHD), can autonomously discover high-performing heuristics. However, existing LLM-AHD frameworks typically treat LLMs as passive generators within fixed workflows, where the model generates heuristics from manually designed, limited context. Such context may fail to capture state-dependent information (e.g., specific failure modes), leading to inefficient trial-and-error exploration. To overcome these limitations, we propose AHD Agent, a novel tool-integrated, multi-turn framework that empowers LLMs to proactively decide whether to generate heuristics or invoke tools to retrieve targeted evidence from the solving environment. translated_title: AHD智能体：用于自动启发式设计的智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.08756v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：自动启发式设计（AHD）已成为解决NP难组合优化问题（COPs）的一种有前景的范式。近期研究表明，大型语言模型（LLMs）在集成到设计良好的框架中（即LLM-AHD）时，可以自主发现高性能的启发式算法。然而，现有的LLM-AHD框架通常将LLMs视为固定工作流中的被动生成器，模型从手动设计的有限上下文中生成启发式算法。这种上下文可能无法捕捉状态相关信息（例如，特定的失败模式），导致低效的试错探索。为克服这些限制，我们提出了AHD智能体，这是一种新颖的工具集成、多轮框架，使LLMs能够主动决定是生成启发式算法还是调用工具从求解环境中检索目标证据。为有效训练这种动态决策智能体，我们引入了...
tldr: 本文提出AHD智能体，一种结合工具集成和多轮交互的强化学习框架，使大语言模型能主动决策生成启发式或检索环境证据，从而提升自动启发式设计的效率和适应性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AHD Agent, a tool-integrated, multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that empowers LLMs to proactively decide between generating heuristics or retrieving environmental evidence, improving efficiency and adaptability in automatic heuristic design.
